name: Free palm treeZ v3 (palm_straight)
changes: OBJ converted to glTF (quads triangulated, V flipped), scaled to 10.5 m and re-pivoted to the trunk base; diffuse with alpha channel brightened (RGB gain 1.75/1.95/1.6; source albedo is very dark) and resized to 1024 px and normal 512 px re-encoded as WebP; alpha-tested (MASK 0.45) double-sided material; translucency/specular maps dropped; float geometry kept unquantized for static batching.
